$comment: Pipeline settings: recorded audio, transcription/alignment, render/export. Visual tokens and series identity live elsewhere.

audio.source: Only the narration file Eyad supplies for the current episode. Never TTS, never a previous episode's or preview's audio.

normalize.method: linear gain only (no compression, no limiting, no EQ, no tempo/pitch change, no trimming)
normalize.rule: If reaching the target would exceed the peak ceiling, apply the largest gain that respects the ceiling and report the resulting loudness.

audio.deliveryChannels: dual-mono stereo (measured the way it plays)
audio.referenceVideoAudio: muted unless the episode storyboard sets allowAudio: true with Eyad's explicit request

compare.$note: Script vs recording differences of 2+ words are reported. ASR on Egyptian Arabic is imperfect; flags mean 'listen here', not proof.

duration.policy: The full recording, from its first to its last sample, plus tailMs of visual hold. No trimming, no speed change.

render.visualIntermediate: prores 422 HQ (rendered once, reused for both MP4s)
